summary: Worlds created with seed "REDApRES" (0) crash when trying to load new 1.18 mountain biomes java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "dfw.a(double, double, double)" because "this.a" is null
description: Basically the title. This doesn t affect any cave biomes. To recreate this you just have to enter "REDApRES" into the seed field and create a new world. After that you can locate and tp walk to any of the new mountain biomes except Meadow and the world will crash. I tried this on a server and the error was "java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "dfw.a(double, double, double)" because "this.a" is null" and the server closed with error code "255". I understand that technically seed "0" isn t even supposed to be entered but it have worked with all previous versions so I think this crash counts as a bug. My guess is that this new mountain generation is completely based on the raw seed so there probably won t be any fix for this bug but I am still reporting it because I often use it and I got hope. Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new world and enter "REDApRES" into the seed field.
3. Create the world.
4. Once the world is loaded, locate any new mountain biome except Meadow.
5. Use the teleport command to move to the new mountain biome (`/tp <your_username> <x> <y> <z>` where `<x>`, `<y>`, and `<z>` are the coordinates of the biome).
6. Wait for the world to generate the new chunks in the mountain biome.
7. Observe that the game crashes with the error "java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke 'dfw.a(double, double, double)' because 'this.a' is null."
Observed Behavior: Worlds created with the seed "REDApRES" (0) experience crashes when attempting to load new mountain biomes introduced in version 1.18, resulting in a java.lang.NullPointerException error message that states "Cannot invoke 'dfw.a(double, double, double)' because 'this.a' is null." This issue is specific to the mountain biomes, as cave biomes remain unaffected. To reproduce this bug, players need to enter "REDApRES" into the seed input field and create a new world. After generating the world, if players teleport or walk to any of the new mountain biomes, except for the Meadow biome, the game will crash. Testing this on a server yielded the same error, which caused the server to shut down with an error code of "255." Although the seed "0" is not officially intended for use, it has functioned correctly in previous game versions, leading to the belief that this crash qualifies as a bug. It is presumed that the new mountain generation relies heavily on the raw seed, suggesting that a fix may be challenging to implement. Despite this, the bug is being reported due to its frequent use by the player and the hope for a resolution. The stack trace associated with the crash indicates an exception generated during the creation of new chunks, pointing to the same NullPointerException error encountered in the gameplay.
Expected Behavior: When a world is created using the seed "REDApRES" (0), it should load successfully without crashing when the player navigates to the new 1.18 mountain biomes. Players should be able to explore these biomes, including Meadow, without encountering any errors or exceptions. The game should generate the terrain and biomes smoothly, allowing for a seamless experience in both single-player and multiplayer modes without any server shutdowns or error messages.
